description: Cognee is the open-source AI memory platform for agents. Give your AI agents persistent long-term memory with small models for free
summary: I like that cognee's core loop—extract a knowledge graph with GLiNER, embed locally, query without ever calling an LLM—actually runs on a laptop CPU, which makes it a plausible persistent-memory layer for the agent sessions I route through PenguPool instead of another cloud dependency I have to trust. The ontology support is the part that hooks me from my bioinformatics days: you define the entities and relations you care about, and the graph respects that structure instead of flattening everything into a vector blob. It's early and the README sells it with "Company Brain" energy, but the local-first quickstart with `cognee[gliner]` is the kind of thing I can wire into a dev loop tonight, watch the graph build, and decide whether it earns a place in the stack.
